svg.title: Figure 11 · Volatility filtering and forecast timing
svg.desc: Synthetic losses driven by EWMA variance with λ = 0.97, seed 4107. Innovations on days 351–370 are deliberately multiplied by three. Forecasts use only earlier losses; the injected episode violates the normal-innovation forecast model.
